seo.title: Cake Bloom | Korean Cakes, Lunchbox Cakes & Custom Birthday Cakes, Jumeirah Dubai
seo.description: Cake Bloom, Umm Suqeim 1 on Jumeirah Road: the UAE's first Korean cakery. Lunchbox cakes, custom piped birthday cakes, mini cakes, cheesecake and coffee. 4.7 from 759 reviews.

hero.lede: Lunchbox cakes, custom piped birthday cakes and the cheese cake Jerry would steal, in a pastel café next to Al Masraf Bank on Jumeirah Road.
hero.image_alt: Cheese-shaped cake with Tom and Jerry figures

address_lines: Umm Suqeim 1, next to Al Masraf Bank, Dubai

items.a: Call us at +971 4 344 6786 with your date and design. Lunchbox cakes are often available the same day; custom designs need more notice.

items.q: Can you write a message or copy a design?
items.a: Yes. Send a reference picture and the text you want piped.
Yes, we deliver across Dubai. You can also pick up in Umm Suqeim 1.
